name: black pudding
desc: Black Pudding is a CR 4 ooze.

actions.name: amorphous
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without &reference[squeezing]{Squeezing}.

actions.name: corrosive form
actions.desc: A creature that touches the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes [[/damage average]] damage. Any nonmagical weapon made of metal or wood that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NwQpeeaMxAC3fRft.Item.wvlDMuDDdk7peoPa.ActiveEffect.dodLAz6LZ0KlsabM]{Corroded Weapon} enchantment to a weapon, granting it a cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls each time the enchantment is applied.

actions.name: pseudopod
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.NwQpeeaMxAC3fRft.Item.v6ZspnPr8G5hApkL.ActiveEffect.4U4SIb01ypbc6lzv]{Corroded Armor} enchantment to a suit of armor, granting it a cumulative -1 to the AC it offers each time the enchantment is applied.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: split
actions.desc: When a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}s if it has at least 10 Hit Points. Each new pudding has Hit Points equal to half the original [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s, rounded down. New [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}s are one size smaller than the original [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.
